facts.text: I am a product design professional.
The cross-functional team way of working is not defined.
People are not clear about roles and responsibilities in my cross-functional team.
I feel very stressed because I have a lot of work to do.
I have to support my squad and my design team to ensure they are doing their job.
I know I need to focus on my portfolio and my career path.
I constantly deprioritise my portfolio and career path.
I feel more stressed about my focus and my ability because I deprioritise my portfolio and career path.
I want to talk to someone to understand whether these issues are common and how to handle them.
I asked for advice on how to advise that person.
I asked whether there is another potential solution.
I asked whether one of the solutions could be a better plan for myself to structure my life.
